title: Common
description: Shared definitions referenced by every Cloudhal contract. Not a root type: the bundler inlines these $defs into each root schema before code generation.

Id.description: Prefixed, URL-safe identifier, e.g. site_01HZX8K3Q9. The prefix names the entity kind; agents and the MCP server pass these as opaque handles.

Revision.description: Monotonic per-node revision used for optimistic locking (compare-and-swap on write).

SchemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Readers reject unknown versions; migrations move documents forward one version at a time.

Locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, e.g. en, tr, en-US.

Metadata.description: Free-form string-to-string map for extensions. Keys should be namespaced (e.g. cloudhal.source).

ActorKind.description: Who performed an action. Humans and agents share one actor model so the policy engine treats them uniformly.

ImageRef.description: Reference to an image. With `assetId` the image is an Asset node (RFC-0004): the store writes its media URL into `src`, and its size into `width` and `height`, as a fallback for readers that do not resolve assets. Without it, `src` is a relative path or an absolute URL, as before.

assetId.description: The Asset node shown (RFC-0004). Renderers that know assets resolve it and ignore `src`.

Path.description: Absolute URL path of a route the site owns: starts with '/', lower-case slug segments, no trailing slash except root.

Seo.description: Search and social metadata of a routable node (page, term archive).

PublishStatus.description: Editorial lifecycle of a page or content entry.

TranslationMethod.description: How a page's or entry's text came to be (RFC-0033). 'original' marks the source of a translation group; 'machine-reviewed' is machine output a person has reviewed.

Translation.description: Links a page or entry to the other language versions of the same work (RFC-0033 §2). Staleness is computed: the source's current hash differs from source.hash.

group.description: The group's id: the original node's id, shared by every translation. May cross sites in one project.

layout.description: linked: the original's structural changes propagate to this translation as drafts (RFC-0033 §4a); independent: nothing propagates. Absent means linked.

source.description: The node and revision this translation was made from. Absent on the original.

siteId.description: The source's site when it is another site of the same project (a language edition). Absent means this site.

hash.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the source node's canonical JSON at that revision.

provenance.description: The machine-translation record: engine, glossary revision, checks run, quality score. Required when method is machine or machine-reviewed.

review.description: The person who reviewed this translation and when. Only humans set it.

TimeZone.description: IANA time zone name from the tz database (RFC-0008), e.g. Europe/Istanbul, America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires, Etc/GMT+3 or UTC. Wall-clock times a person enters are kept with their zone, so the instant is recomputed when governments change the rules. The pattern bounds the shape only; writers also check the name against the runtime's Intl zone list.

LocalDateTime.description: A wall-clock date and time without an offset, to the minute (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm), as a person entered it; always paired with a TimeZone (RFC-0008).

Availability.description: Time gates of a page or content entry (RFC-0008): the published site shows the node only from `from` (inclusive: an embargo) until `until` (exclusive: an expiry), checked at render time, so the gates hold even when no scheduler runs. Before `from` and from `until` on, the node is absent from every public route, list, feed, sitemap and search output; previews still show it. At least one gate; writers check that `from` is before `until`.

BodyProfile.description: The markdown dialect a body follows (RFC-0014 §1): 1 = Cloudhal Markdown v1 (CommonMark + GFM + `asset:` + directives; raw HTML escaped). Set by the store on markdown bodies.

BodyBlock.description: One top-level block of a markdown body in the store's index (RFC-0014 §3). Written by the store only: a client's values are replaced on every write. `by`, `via` and `at` say who last changed the block's content, through which channel and when; they are absent for content written before the index existed.

id.description: Stable across writes that keep the block's content or its place among unchanged blocks.

hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the block's markdown without trailing whitespace.

BodyBlocks.description: A markdown body's block index, in body order (RFC-0014 §3). Absent means not indexed (yet, or an HTML body), never empty.

MotionLevel.description: How much a page may move (RFC-0024 §1); the reader's reduced-motion preference and pause control can only lower it.

SurfaceComponentId.description: A component's id, unique within its surface; `root` is the tree's root (RFC-0020 §1).

SurfaceComponent.description: One element of a generative UI surface (RFC-0020 §1), in a flat list: `component` names a catalog entry (a PascalCase built-in primitive such as `Stack`, or a registry block type such as `callout`), `children` refer to other ids of the same surface, and `props` follow the entry's schema, which the store checks. Field names follow A2UI v0.9.

props.description: Literal values, `{path}` bindings into the surface's data, or `{call}` named functions; validated by the store against the catalog, not by this contract.

visible.description: A visibility condition over the surface's data (`eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `and`, `or`, `not`); validated by the store.

motion.description: Motion presets for this component (RFC-0024 §2): `reveal`, `hover`, `speed`, `delay`, `stagger`, `replay` and later `scroll`, `loop`; enums and clamped numbers only, validated by the store against the catalog. The renderer turns them into CSS; agents never write CSS.
